Package edu.cnu.mdi.util

Class Ping

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.util.Ping
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class Ping extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Simple Swing-based timer that periodically notifies registered IPing listeners.

Internally this class uses a Timer, so all callbacks occur on the Swing Event Dispatch Thread (EDT). This makes it suitable for driving lightweight UI updates, animation steps, or regular housekeeping work in an MDI application.

Example: 


 Ping ping = new Ping(500); // fire every 500 ms
 ping.addPingListener(() -> {
 	// e.g. repaint a status component
 });

 // Later, when you no longer need it:
 ping.stop(); // or ping.close();

    • Ping

      public Ping(int delayInMillis, boolean startImmediately)
      Creates a new Ping that fires at the specified interval.
      Parameters:
      delayInMillis - the delay between pings in milliseconds; must be positive
      startImmediately - if true, the timer is started as soon as the Ping is created; otherwise it remains stopped until start() is called
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if delayInMillis <= 0

  • Method Details

    • start

      public void start()
      Starts the underlying timer if it is not already running.

      All subsequent ticks will result in calls to IPing.ping() for each registered listener until stop() or close() is called.

    • stop

      public void stop()
      Stops the underlying timer. No further IPing.ping() callbacks will occur until start() is called again.

    • isRunning

      public boolean isRunning()
      Returns true if the underlying timer is currently running.

    • close

      public void close()
      Stops the timer and releases any resources held by this Ping.

      This method simply calls stop() and is provided so that Ping can be used with try-with-resources: 

      
 try (Ping ping = new Ping(250)) {
     ping.addPingListener(...);
     // use ping
 }
 // timer automatically stopped here
      Specified by:
      close in interface AutoCloseable
